title: Width scan of a serialized formula
statement: For every CNF formula $\varphi$ over variables indexed by $\mathbb{N}$, the width scan of its serialization equals the Boolean test that is true exactly when every clause of $\varphi$ has at most three literal occurrences.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a CNF formula over natural-number variables
replaced:
For every CNF formula $\varphi$, the width scan of the serialization of $\varphi$
equals the Boolean width-three test of $\varphi$, which is true exactly when every
clause of $\varphi$ has at most three literal occurrences.
